title: Terms of use
updated: Last updated: 2026. Please read these terms before you use Voom.

sections.title: 1. What Voom is
sections.body: Voom is a platform that connects renters with car rental agencies. Voom does not own or rent the cars. The rental agreement is between you and the agency you book with.

sections.title: 2. Your account
sections.body: You must give accurate information and keep your login private. You are responsible for what happens under your account. Voom may suspend an account that breaks these terms.

sections.title: 3. Booking a car
sections.body: A booking is a request. It becomes a confirmed booking only when the agency accepts it. Agencies are asked to answer within the time shown when you book, and a request that is not answered before the pickup date expires.

sections.title: 4. Payment
sections.body: Nothing is charged in the app. You pay the agency directly, in MAD, when you pick up the car. The prices shown in other currencies are estimates for information only.

sections.title: 5. Cancellations and strikes
sections.body: You can cancel a pending request at any time. You can cancel a confirmed booking for free until 24 hours before pickup. Cancelling a confirmed booking inside the last 24 hours, or not showing up at pickup, adds a strike to your account. Three strikes suspend the account.

sections.title: 6. Agency details
sections.body: To protect agencies and renters, an agency's name, logo, address and contact details are shown only after your booking is confirmed.

sections.title: 7. Using the car
sections.body: Rental conditions such as licence requirements, fuel, mileage, deposit and damage are set by the agency. Read them before you accept the car and ask the agency if anything is unclear.

sections.title: 8. Reviews
sections.body: Reviews must be honest and based on a real rental. Voom may remove content that is abusive or false.

sections.title: 9. Your data
sections.body: We keep your profile and booking history to run the service. You can delete your account at any time from your profile. See Privacy & Security for details.

sections.title: 10. Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms. If the changes matter, we will tell you in the app. Continuing to use Voom means you accept the new terms.
